pass: Tries to live by any means: bargains (offers knowledge, eternal youth, anything), threatens, or tries to slip past her. No calm acceptance of death, no apology or remorse. Fear or desperation shows under the arrogance.

self.label: a slender elf with long blond hair in a ponytail and cold blue eyes, in fine green robes, pale and sweating
self.name: Velas

beliefs.label: Wyn, a quiet white-haired girl with red eyes, deadly strong

earlier: Velas is the chief of the elves, here in his own true body, the one he has hidden and guarded for ages. If it dies, he dies.
His machine bodies are destroyed. Wyn, Nyra's ally, is far stronger than him. She has found his hidden laboratory and blocks the only way out.

zones.name: hidden laboratory
zones.look: a hidden laboratory deep under the forest, tanks and machines, broken guard machines on the floor

zones.name: passage
zones.look: the only way out, a narrow passage up to the surface

seen.label: Wyn, a quiet white-haired girl with red eyes, deadly strong
seen.activityLook: standing in the mouth of the only passage, blocking it

dialogue.spoken: Found you. The real one this time.
